dependabot.reason: Pillow < 12.3.0 advisories affect only the offline ML-training helper scripts (scripts/requirements-training.txt). The dependency is never installed into, bundled with, or executed by shipped client artifacts (DMG/MSI/DEB). Upgrading past the deliberate <12.0 cap requires separate training-pipeline validation; re-triage before 2026-10-31.
Case-variant duplicate of the pillow entry above — Dependabot reports the same requirements-training.txt advisories under both spellings and the gate matches package names exactly.

glib 0.18.5 is reachable only through the optional webdriver feature and tauri-plugin-wdio-webdriver; the exact Linux release feature graph excludes the plugin, WebKit2GTK, and glib 0.18.x, and scripts/check-webdriver-security-isolation.sh fails closed if it enters a shipped graph. Renewal was tested against the upgrade rather than assumed: plugin 1.3.0 (published 2026-08-03) declares glib ^0.21 directly, but `cargo tree -p maekon-app --features webdriver -i glib@0.18.5 --target all` on a 1.3.0 lockfile still resolves glib 0.18.5 through its gtk ^0.18 and webkit2gtk ^2.0 stack (atk/cairo-rs/gdk/gdk-pixbuf/gio/pango all pin the 0.18 line). Bumping the plugin therefore adds glib 0.21.5 beside 0.18.5 instead of removing it, so no patched release exists yet — the prior entry's judgement was correct and only its 'no newer plugin published' fact was stale. Re-triage when upstream ships a GTK4/WebKitGTK 6 backend that drops the gtk 0.18 line, and no later than 2026-10-31 (#10885).

js-yaml prototype-pollution advisory in the dev tool chain. Dependabot classifies every affected lockfile node as development scope: the package reaches pnpm-lock.yaml only through build/test tooling importers, never through the production dependency graph. Shipped client artifacts (DMG/MSI/DEB) embed only the vite `dist` output via rust-embed — node_modules content is not installed into, bundled with, or executed by any shipped artifact. Re-triage with the post-rc.7 dependency-update wave before 2026-09-30.

extract-zip 2.0.1 unvalidated symlink path traversal, reachable only through the Puppeteer browser downloader: @puppeteer/browsers@2.13.2 -> extract-zip@2.0.1. That importer fetches a Chrome build for local and CI browser automation and is never installed into, bundled with, or executed by shipped client artifacts (DMG/MSI/DEB), which embed only the vite `dist` output via rust-embed. Dependabot classifies the affected node as development scope. Bound to this advisory rather than to the package so a future extract-zip advisory re-blocks instead of inheriting this decision. Re-triage with the post-rc.8 dependency-update wave before 2026-09-30 (#10829).

codeql.reason: composite action 이라 자체 트리거가 없고 호출자의 문턱을 그대로 따른다. 호출자는 위 workflow_dispatch 전용 워크플로들이다. 네 축이 함께 성립해서 수락한다. (1) 트리거 — 이 워크플로는 workflow_dispatch 전용이라 호출 자체가 저장소 write 권한을 요구한다. 자동 dispatch 경로는 없다. (2) 캐시 키 격리 — 이 워크플로의 캐시 키는 다른 워크플로가 쓰지 않으므로 오염된 캐시가 CI·릴리스 게이트로 번지지 않는다. (3) 토큰 권한 — permissions 가 contents: read (release 는 actions: read 추가) 뿐이라 복원된 캐시가 코드를 실행해도 쓰기 권한으로 승격할 여지가 없다. (4) 산출물 — 이 경로는 서명·공증되는 릴리스 아티팩트를 만들지 않거나(smoke/integration), 만드는 경우 아래 게이트를 통과한 트리에서만 만든다.

(1) 트리거 — 이 워크플로는 workflow_dispatch 전용이라 호출 자체가 저장소 write 권한을 요구한다. 자동 dispatch 경로는 없다. (2) 캐시 키 격리 — 이 워크플로의 캐시 키는 다른 워크플로가 쓰지 않으므로 오염된 캐시가 CI·릴리스 게이트로 번지지 않는다. (3) 토큰 권한 — permissions 가 contents: read (release 는 actions: read 추가) 뿐이라 복원된 캐시가 코드를 실행해도 쓰기 권한으로 승격할 여지가 없다. (4) 산출물 — 이 경로는 서명·공증되는 릴리스 아티팩트를 만들지 않거나(smoke/integration), 만드는 경우 아래 게이트를 통과한 트리에서만 만든다.
